prompt.text: No model and no prompt: made in code from the ingested ships/manta-thruster frames (the GEN10 s-manta-thruster winner, shipped as the v2 override PNG). The GEN12 ask s-kestrel-thruster STOP@8d (no generated sheet passed its probe; w15-GEN12-report section Wave-6 recommendation 1), so the KESTREL flame is the proven MANTA flame recoloured by the nearest-luma law onto the three warm design colours the ask names (body #e84818, inner glow #f8c030, white-hot heart #fff8d0) — same geometry, same four-frame flicker ladder, same nozzle-right placement, the interim map palette.

notes: s-kestrel-thruster (gen12, STOP@8 — w15-GEN12-report §Wave-6 rec 1): ships/kestrel-thruster v2 (4 flicker frames 9x5 native, burn loop LOW/HIGH/SPARK/SURGE grammar; nozzle on the RIGHT edge, the anchor [9,2] keeps the attachment point; hitFlash false, no @flash sibling). No generated sheet passed the probe, so the flame is the ingested ships/manta-thruster frames recoloured in code by the committed art-prompts/v2/code-frames/make_kestrel_thruster.mjs (model code, deterministic byte-exact re-run, --check proven): every pixel keeps its alpha and position, each colour maps to the nearest KESTREL design colour in Rec.601 integer luma — the ask names exactly three (body #e84818, inner glow #f8c030, white-hot heart #fff8d0), the interim map palette, so no colour is invented and no step is improvised. The per-ship p2 byte-reverse convention applies (the sidecar map is the three served colours byte-reversed, identical to the interim map p2 pairs). The design carries its own outline, so the outline pass is off.
